# CodePipelineProcessStartConfig

An automation action (`$type` is `codepipeline`) that starts a code pipeline run. The code pipeline is named by `name` and `namespaceName`, not by `version`; `request` is the start request to send.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests and responses. In a request it is called `CodePipelineProcessStartConfigInput`.

## In a request

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | `string` |  | The name of the code pipeline to start. |
| `namespaceName` | `string` |  | The name of the namespace the code pipeline is in. |
| `request` | [`CodePipelineProcessStartRequestInput`](code-pipeline-process-start-request.md#in-a-request) |  | The start request to send, exactly as for starting the code pipeline directly: inputs, repositories, extra steps, agent overrides, credentials, mounts, input files and so on. |
| `version` | [`VersionReference`](version-reference.md)`\| null` |  | The app, interaction or capsule to start, and the version of it. Required for those three; left out for `codepipeline` (named by `name`) and `interaction-message` (which names a run). |
